metadata.note: This is a synthetic rule-based stress run, not an LLM result or a psychological validation.

WorldValidity.basis: accepted is binary and all trajectory rows parse

InformationIntegrity.reason: current batch has no hidden-information intervention labels

CausalResponsiveness.basis: diagnostic action-change rate after emitted world events; not an intervention causal estimate

Persistence.basis: active commitment carried to next decision with same task id or suspension

Recovery.basis: interrupted task returns to active/suspended within five decisions

CharacterDifferentiation.basis: pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence of chosen-action distributions across generated personalities

BehavioralDiversity.basis: unique chosen actions / decision points per run

Believability.reason: no blind external judge or human pairwise panel in v0

Efficiency.basis: synthetic batch uses zero LLM calls; runtime/token telemetry not yet instrumented
